timeline.title: The room existed before the launch
timeline.detail: TypeSafe's Discord #show-and-tell channel opens during stealth. By Sep 17 it holds 714 shared links — the community was assembling before Jev had a name in public.

timeline.title: Jev launches out of stealth
timeline.detail: TypeSafe AI announces System One Models, $40M seed led by DCVC, early access opens. Launch thread hits 1,835 points / 482 comments on Hacker News within a day.

timeline.title: The Doom demo circulates
timeline.detail: @CompleteSkeptic's launch video — Jev playing Doom from structured game state — becomes the most-shared artifact of the launch on X.

timeline.title: Mario. 90 seconds.
timeline.detail: @faadilhshaik posts Jev playing Super Mario Bros. from RAM state. The tweet clears 2,278 likes; the repo github.com/fhshaik/typesafe-mario is pushed 90 seconds after the post goes live.

timeline.title: The ecosystem big bang
timeline.detail: GitHub search counts 568+ repos mentioning Jev in 72 hours: reverse-engineered replicas, drone stacks, trading bots, SDKs in four languages, security benches, awesome lists.

got @typesafeai's new model Jev to play Super Mario Bros.

I'm excited to see what can be done with these new models!

marioArchitecture: NES emulator → telemetry/RAM parser → object-centric JSON (Mario motion, jump trajectory, enemies, terrain, control results) → Jev Choice → controller input → emulator advances frames. The model never sees a screenshot.
